drawings.description: schéma en haut à droite de la page, sans flèches : les deux arcs extérieurs, marqués $M'$ et $M$, joignent $N$ et $N'$ à $G$ ($M' = G/N$, $M = G/N'$). « $NN' = H$ » est écrit sur un « $MM'$ » effacé. Le « 3 » bouclé $\mathfrak{z}$ désigne ici $N \cap N' = \pi_1$.
drawings.notes: Subgroup diagram without arrows: N and N' under N cap N' = z (looped 3) = pi_1 at the top, both joined to NN' = H in the middle, itself joined to G at the bottom; the two outer arcs, labelled M' and M, join N and N' to G. The erased MM' under « NN' = H » is left out.

drawings.description: à côté, un petit croquis : deux axes en croix, deux petits traits sur l'axe vertical et un sur l'axe horizontal, deux points dans le quadrant supérieur droit.
drawings.notes: Two axes crossing at one computed point; two short ticks on the vertical axis above the crossing, one tick on the horizontal axis to the right of it; two points in the upper right quadrant, at the heights of the two ticks (they read as the points (p, q) of the spectral sequence written beside the sketch). No label. The transcription's note matches. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: the vertical axis is not straight on the page: it leans right going up and its top bends back to the left; drawn straight it stood up to 4 units left of the page at the upper tick, which on the page points to the right of the axis; both axes are now traced through points of the page and the ticks placed where they stand.
